title: HCX Generation Adapter Manifest v0.1
description: Turn P11-A: one record per HCX_CHAT_COMPLETIONS ModelAdapter construction/usage, carrying only non-secret configuration identity (never a raw API key, raw prompt, or raw provider response body -- only hashes/ids of them) plus honest call-performed flags that distinguish a real external HyperCLOVA X call from a local loopback mock call. This is deliberately separate from telemetry-event.schema.json (which already covers per-question model_call_attempt/success/failure_count, model_failure_code, model_fallback_used, scoring_eligible) and from benchmark-run-manifest.schema.json (which pins agent_variant/dataset/budget reproducibility for a whole run) -- this manifest is scoped ONLY to the generation adapter's own config/security identity and never duplicates or replaces either.

provider_id.description: Free-text provider label carried through from ModelConfig.provider (e.g. "hcx"). Never used to select a code path.

model_id.description: Free-text model label carried through from ModelConfig.model. Never hardcoded inside adapter code.

model_config_sha256.description: sha256 of the canonicalized ModelConfig (reproducibility.mjs's computeModelConfigSha256). ModelConfig never contains the API key itself, so this is always safe to record.

endpoint_sha256.description: sha256 of the full endpoint_url string. Recorded instead of the raw URL so a query-string credential (if a provider ever used one, which HCX's env-var-key contract does not) could never leak through this manifest.

endpoint_hostname.description: Non-secret hostname parsed from endpoint_url (e.g. "clovastudio.stream.ntruss.com" or "127.0.0.1" for a test mock). A hostname alone never carries a credential.

endpoint_is_loopback.description: true when endpoint_hostname is 127.0.0.1/localhost/::1 -- the ONLY case a mock call could have been authorized without actual_external_call_authorized=true.

prompt_template_id.description: Stable id of the fixed instructional prompt template used, if any (e.g. an AgentFlow's own ANSWER_PROMPT_TEMPLATE_ID). null when no model call was attempted.

prompt_template_sha256.description: sha256 of the FIXED template text only, never of any per-question filled prompt.

code_revision.description: git revision (optionally "-dirty") of the working tree that constructed this adapter (reproducibility.mjs's detectCodeRevision), or "unknown".

actual_external_call_authorized.description: Mirrors ModelConfig.actual_external_call_authorized exactly -- Owner-controlled real-call authorization. false throughout this Turn.

actual_external_generation_call_performe.description: true only if a real, non-loopback HCX network call actually completed. Always false in this Turn -- a mock/loopback call is NEVER counted here, however many times it was made.

mock_generation_call_performed.description: true when this adapter made at least one call against a loopback (127.0.0.1/localhost/::1) mock target this Turn's mock server (see hcx-mock-server.mjs). false for a manifest describing an adapter that was constructed but never called, or that was refused construction entirely.
